notes: Live catalogue confirmed (title 'Homeware & Gifting | Designer Home Decor - AMARA', canonical https://www.amara.com). Direct IPv4 fetch timed out; access route used was curl_cffi impersonation (chrome124 and other Chrome/Safari/Edge/Firefox profiles all succeeded 200, no WAF resistance found). Counts verified via the server-rendered 'N' marker embedded in each category page's own HTML (legacy .NET platform, category container data-category=AMAR_SHOPxxx, data-defaultpagelength=60) -- this is server-side rendered at request time, not a client JS-computed total. Cross-checked exhaustively on the two largest leaves (Plates=55, Photo Frames=32): counted unique li-productid tile IDs on the rendered page and both matched totalProducts exactly (55=55, 32=32); every leaf in this file is well under the 60-item page size so no further pagination was needed. Additionally cross-verified multiple parent/child arithmetic: Decorative Accessories 142 = sum of its 9 children exactly; Serveware 35 = sum of its 6 children exactly; Tea & Coffee 49 = Teacups&Saucers5+MilkJugs4+Mugs37+Teapots3 exactly; Mirrors 2 = WallMirrors1+BathroomMirrors1 exactly; Tableware 96 = Bowls37+Plates55+SaltAndPepper4 exactly (Salt & Pepper excluded as a functional condiment tool, not decor); Lighting 9 = IndoorLighting7(=TableLamps6+CeilingLights1)+LampShades2 exactly. Dead/retired slugs found and excluded: /shop/wall-lights, /shop/floor-lamps, /shop/outdoor-lighting all resolve to SearchNoResults (stale text links left in the Lighting page's own descriptive copy referencing categories that no longer exist as live nodes) -- confirms Amara's live Lighting department is currently very small (9 products total site-wide) despite marketing itself as a 'Luxury Lighting' destination; this was verified, not assumed. Rule 0.6 overlaps documented: Wall Decor (10) and Wall Clocks vs Clocks (7=7) each returned identical totalProducts to a sibling-named URL (wall-plates=10, wall-clocks=7) -- treated as the same population under two URLs and NOT double-counted, only one leaf emitted per pair. Dressing Table Accessories (27, room-based Bedroom node, kept per Rule 0 since product type is decorative jewellery/trinket boxes) was inspected via product-tile li-subcategory tags: composed of Jewellery Storage 17 + Jewellery and Watch Boxes 1 (=Jewellery Boxes 18 leaf) plus Trinket Boxes 5 and Trinket Trays 4 which are the IDENTICAL populations already counted once under Decorative Accessories -- those two were dropped here per Rule 0.6's same-listing exception, only Jewellery Boxes is emitted as a new leaf. Candle Holders & Accessories (29) does not cleanly equal the sum of its 5 type-specific pages (31) -- product-tile inspection showed the rollup and the type pages are differently curated, not a strict duplicate, so treated as a mixed-rollup parent row (no qty, per 'mixed roll-ups: drop them don't pad') with all 5 type pages kept as its verified children. Bathroom Accessories (5) inspected via product tags: 1 mirror (duplicate of Bathroom Mirrors, already counted) + Soap Dispensers + Bins + Toothbrush Holders (all bathroom hardware/utility, excluded per Rule 0.4) -- entire node dropped except the already-captured mirror. Excluded as out of scope: Home Fragrance/scented candles/diffusers, Christmas, Gifts, Furniture, Bedding/Soft Furnishings/Rugs/Throws/Curtains (textiles), Storage/Bins, Kitchenware/Cookware/Kitchen Appliances, Cutlery/Chopsticks/Water Bottles/Salt & Pepper (functional dining tools), Desk Accessories/Home Office Accessories (stationery), Coffee Table Books (reading material, not an approved decor product type despite 'Decorative Books' marketing), Games & Puzzles, Outdoors (garden/picnic/furniture -- no live outdoor lighting or outdoor decorative-mirror node found), Artificial Flowers, Cat & Dog Accessories, Stereos & Speakers, Bathroom storage/plumbing/hardware. Rule 0 gain: Bathroom Mirrors (1) and Dressing Table Accessories/Jewellery Boxes (18, Bedroom room node) were included under Rule 0 despite carrying room words, because product type (mirror; decorative box) is an approved type.
